headline: Startup now tells the truth about context pressure.

items.title: Startup context percent truth restored
items.insight: Startup pressure now comes from token counts. Future sessions see real context risk instead of an inflated closeout signal.

items.title: Startup context age fallback restored
items.insight: The brief now uses project status when Current State lacks a date header. A missing Markdown header no longer becomes an unknown freshness signal.

items.title: Startup meter regression gate hardened
items.insight: The freshness gate now checks the rendered math, not only the verdict text. Stale urgent briefs and bad percentages fail before they steer work.
